BC, CG Supervisor, Houdini Experience

This position is based in Vancouver. All applicants must reside in British Columbia Canada.

About Zoic

Zoic Studios is a Visual Effects company that specializes in high end visual effects for television, film, and advertising. Our mantra is Visual Evolution - we focus on every part of the process, from the final picture to the pipeline used to create them.

Are you looking for your next creative and technical challenge? Come join our team!

Why Join Zoic?

  • We are an Artist owned and operated VFX studio.
  • We love what we do and always stay curious about new technology and techniques.
  • We respect work/life balance in a hectic industry.
  • We work with a team from all walks of life and backgrounds.

Zoic Studios is seeking a CG Supervisor with Houdini Experience..

This is a key position that will advise the VFX Supervisor and/or Creative Director regarding the technical and creative capabilities and limitations of the 3D team and work collaboratively to provide solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Advise on 3D workflow to aid VFX Supervisor/Creative Director and Producer in bidding and shot methodology planning
  • Interpret creative needs into actionable tasks. Identify refine and establish 3D workflow based on the needs of the show
  • Oversee the 3D look development of key shots/sequences in conjunction with 2D look dev leads and supervisors
  • Proactively communicate with relevant Supervisors and Production team members to ensure all necessary individuals and departments are aware of shot statuses and potential issues
  • Select, mentor, train and manage teams of up to 10 artists
  • Provide artist performance feedback to direct reports and management
  • Attend dailies, interviews, administrative and managerial meetings as required

Qualifications

  • Minimum 8 years experience within live action VFX
  • Minimum 2 years experience as a 3D Supervisor with a proven track record of delivering shows, driving methodology and leading teams of artists
  • Expert knowledge in Houdini, Karma
  • Expert knowledge in Maya,
  • Working knowledge in Mari, Nuke.
  • Substance, Speedtree and Houdini/Mantra an asset
  • Experience in all aspects of the 3D Pipeline: modelling, texturing, shading, colour theory (technical & creative), lighting and rendering experience
  • Ability to evaluate workload vs. resources and provide accurate delivery estimates
  • Collaborative leadership style; always working to achieve common goals in terms of delivery and quality
  • Exceptional interpersonal communication including conflict resolution, negotiation, note interpretation, creative to technical translation, technical to creative translation
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical, creative and interpersonal issues
  • Ability to adapt to changing priories or new technology / processes as required
  • Must provide up to date reel and resume showcasing listed skills

Additional information

  • British Columbia Employees Pay Range for CG Supervisor is $150K - $160K (The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including without limitation, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and if applicable, the location of the position)
  • This position is based in Vancouver. All applicants must reside in British Columbia Canada. (Some USA Candidates will be considered).
  • Zoic does not cover relocation costs.
  • All remote positions require the candidate to have a reliable internet connection via ethernet and work on Pacific Standard Time.
  • This job description contains the basic requirements for the position and is NOT intended to be a complete list of responsibilities; other duties may be assigned.
  • Due to the sheer volume of applications, we receive, we regret that only those selected to interview will be contacted.

Who We Are

At Amsive, we're more than just a performance marketing agency; we're a team that thrives on collaboration and innovation. We offer a supportive environment where personal growth is just as important as professional development. We're a team of passionate individuals ready to tackle challenges, learn from one another, and drive results. We believe in empowering our team members, providing them with the tools they need to succeed, and trusting them to lead the way. With decades of expertise and a commitment to integrated solutions, we don't meet the industry standard; we're setting it.

If you're looking for a place where your work matters, a career path you can grow on your terms, and a team that's as invested in your success as you are, Amsive is for you. We offer a unique blend of flexibility, growth opportunities, and a culture that values each individual. Join us, and be part of the team ready to welcome, support, and grow with you.
*We regret to inform you that currently, Amsive DOES NOT provide sponsorship opportunities.*
*This is a 3 month contract position to start, with the possibility to become a full time hire*

**This is a REMOTE position. Candidates can be located anywhere in US time zones. Candidates will be required to work ET or CT time zone. Nashville Metropolitan area is a plus.**

What we are looking for:

Amsive is looking for a Project Manager, Social & Influencer who thrives in a fast-moving environment, loves keeping complex programs organized, and can bring calm structure and accountability to creative chaos. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced agency environment and has a strong project management mindset.

The Project Manager, Social & Influencer will ensure all department projects move efficiently from strategy through creative, influencer, and reporting phases. Acting as the connective tissue across the department’s accounts, this person maintains visibility into workloads, manages timelines and dependencies, and ensures deliverables are completed on time, within scope, and at the highest quality.

What you will be doing:
  • Support the intake and resourcing process for new client requests and ongoing programs, ensuring briefs are complete and timelines established.
  • Set up Asana projects with clear tasks, dependencies, and owners.
  • Ensure all relevant documents, brand assets, and resources are organized and accessible.
  • Partner with Operations Manager to confirm scope, resources, and deliverable expectations at kickoff.
  • Build and maintain detailed Asana timelines; proactively adjust for client or internal delays.
  • Act as the single source of truth for project status across the team.
  • Track milestones and dependencies; manage communication of progress and risks.
  • Keep all stakeholders aligned on next steps and timing.
  • Support Operations Manager in assessing team capacity, resourcing needs, and contractor utilization.
  • Uphold department use of standard templates, briefs, and reporting formats.
  • Conduct light QA to ensure deliverables meet original request criteria and brand standards.
  • Route assets for review, collect and organize feedback, and confirm revisions are implemented.
  • Coordinate deliverable and meeting schedules; handle logistics for cross-functional collaboration and status reviews.
  • Act as the day-to-day contact for trafficking requests, asset routing, and communications triage.
  • Collaborate with teams to ensure alignment and on-time delivery.
  • Track vendor, contractor, and influencer deliverables. Confirming progress and completion in partnership with Operations Manager and Account Managers.
  • Help evaluate daily workloads and flag when additional support or reallocation is needed.
  • Model calm, accountability, and operational discipline in daily workflow.
  • Reinforce the Social + Influencer team’s process standards and Asana best practices.
  • Identify recurring friction points and propose process improvements.
  • Contribute to a culture of clear communication, shared ownership, and proactive problem-solving.

Who you are:
  • 3–5 years of project-management experience within a marketing, creative, or social-media agency environment.
  • Strong familiarity with social + influencer workflows (creative production, posting, reporting, influencer/creator programs, community management).
  • Advanced proficiency in Asana (required); comfortable with Microsoft365, Brandwatch, Sprout Social, Loomly, Hootsuite, Slack, Sprout Social Influencer Marketing (Tagger), and Canva.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and calm under pressure.
  • A proactive communicator who balances urgency with empathy and collaboration.

raw.title: Backend-Entwickler (Scala) (m/w/d) - Hochqualifiziertes Team, Flexibel, Home Off
raw.excerpt: Was suchen wir?  Wir sind ein Team von hochqualifizerten Software-Entwicklern und wir suchen Verstärkung.
raw.description:
Was suchen wir?
Wir sind ein Team von hochqualifizerten Software-Entwicklern und wir suchen Verstärkung. Wir arbeiten mit spannenden Kunden in Deutschland und den USA. Du willst uns mit deinen technischen Fähigkeiten nach Vorne bringen? Dann bewirb dich!
Warum bei uns?
Wir sind ein extrem fortschrittliches Unternehmen. Nicht nur setzen wir bei Thema Mitarbeiter-Einbindung, Flexibilität und Arbeitsklima ganz neue Maßstäbe - wir sind auch immer daran interessiert, unsere Kunden technisch nach vorne zu katapultieren.
In diesem Sinne: Du hast keinen bock auf Uralt-Technologien und stundenlange sinnbefreite Meetings? Du willst an spannenden, produktiven Projekten arbeiten? Wir setzen auf einen modernem Tech-Stack (React, React Native, Scala, GraphQL, Relay, Tailwind, Twin, etc. pp.) und anspruchsvolle Aufgaben.
Und es wird noch besser: Wir arbeiten fully-remote mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten ohne nervige U-Bahn-Fahrten ins Büro oder Pflichtbeginn um 9 Uhr. Wir erwarten dafür Leistungs- und Lernbereitschaft. Das heißt aber auch, dass du bei uns in 6 Monaten soviel lernen kannst wie in großen Unternehmen in 5 Jahren.
Wer sind wir?
Wir sind eine Software- und Startup-Schmiede in einem. Auf der einen Seite machen wir Projektarbeit für Kunden, auf der anderen Seite gründen wir eigene Startups. Drei erfolgreiche Beispiele: thekey.academy, thekey.community und projexion.io Wir arbeiten nur mit Kunden mit denen wir arbeiten wollen. Auf Nervprojekte haben wir keine Lust. Wir organisieren uns flexibel und geben allen Mitarbeitern viel Spielraum für eigene Entscheidungen. Du möchtest gerne bestimmte Technologien verwenden? Du möchtest experimentieren? Kein Problem.
Was bringst du mit?
Lernbereitschaft, Auge für Qualität und eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise. Du bringst ein paar Jahre Backend-Erfahrung mit und verstehst, wie man Backend-Projekte richtig strukturiert, aufbaut und maintainet.
Du sprichst Deutsch so, dass du dich mit unseren Kunden produktiv unterhalten kannst. Wenn du Zertifikate hast, dann irgendwas in Richtung C1∕C2. Dein permanenter Wohnsitz ist Deutschland. Es ist unendlich kompliziert Menschen aus anderen Ländern zu beschäftigen (Thema Steuern, Meldungen, etc), deshalb muss Deutschland dein permanenter Wohnsitz sein. Wenn du das halbe Jahr auf den Malediven am Strand verbringst und von dort arbeiten willst, ist das völlig OK.
Berufserfahrung: Backend-Entwicklung: 5 Jahre (Erforderlich) Sprache: Deutsch (mindestens C1-Niveau) (Erforderlich)

Was kann dir the key - technology bieten

  • anspruchsvolle Aufgaben rund um die Themen Scala, Software-Architektur und sonstige Entwicklung
  • sehr hoch qualifizierte Kollegen
  • arbeite von überall auf der Welt (Wohnsitz Deutschland)
  • maximale Flexibilität (teile dir deine Arbeitszeiten selbst ein)
  • bearbeite deine Projekte selbstständig, ohne bemuttert zu werden
  • unbefristete Festanstellung
  • erhalte 60000-92000€ je nach Qualifikation (+ Bonussystem mit monatlicher Extra-Vergütung)
  • und sowas wie "das machen wir schon immer so" gibt es bei uns nicht. Dein Wort hat Gewicht!
